tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Check any receipt by its id: the hash, the signature and its place in the chain. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: The audit trail of a firm's own AI agents: every cleared read, in order, under the firm's key.

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: A signed statement of a firm's receipts for a period, for books and records and for its auditor.

tools.name: issue_auditor_key
tools.description: A firm gives its auditor a key to read and verify the firm's receipts independently.

tools.name: write_receipt
tools.description: Called by Allooloo's own MCPs when a read is cleared. One receipt per cleared read.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "write_receipt" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Write one v1 receipt for a read a gate has cleared. Authenticated: Authorization: Bearer <writer token>. Idempotent on (writer, subject, subject_type, market, rule_version, cleared_at, answer_hash). Returns the receipt." → after: "Called by Allooloo's own MCPs when a read is cleared. One receipt per cleared read."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
